measurement_procedure: Number of distinct (cognitive_state_dominant, agent_role) tuples in the cohort, normalized by cohort size. Low diversity → narrow capability access.

threshold_function.concern_direction_semantics: Consumer emits negative-scored attestation when metric is at-or-below threshold_value. Single-pole concern: high values at this axis are not currently flagged (see rationale).
threshold_function.rationale: cap_diversity low = capability monoculture / lockstep (single-pole concern). Upper bound (high cap_diversity = fragmentation) is structurally meaningful but is provisionally not flagged as failure mode in v1 pending CIRISAgent#880 capability-as-declared signal.

notes: PROXY: capability-as-revealed-by-action; capability-as-declared requires agent capability registry not in dump. CIRISAgent-side ticket filed.
